name: Oman
famous_for: Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, frankincense tree groves in Dhofar, Bimmah Sinkhole, ancient Nizwa fort, and emerald wadis.
tourists: Over 3.2M tourists annually; famous for Wahiba Sands desert, Wadi Shab turquoise pools, and green Khareef monsoon in Salalah.
must_know: Frankincense resin has been harvested in Dhofar for over 5,000 years, once traded like gold to Pharaohs and Roman Emperors.
fun_fact: Oman is one of the oldest independent states in the Arab world, maintaining ancient dhow wooden shipbuilding traditions in Sur.
